question.text: Changes in the PPM of Category I and II AIFs shall be intimated to investors and SEBI within:

answer.text: 1 month of the end of each financial year on a consolidated basis

explanation.text: The Logic: All changes in terms of the PPM and fund documents shall be intimated to investors and to SEBI on a consolidated basis, within one month of the end of each financial year. The intimation must specifically identify the changes and include the relevant revised sections or clauses of the PPM/fund documents. The workbook separately addresses how material changes are handled through the prescribed material-change and exit-process framework. The Trap: The 15-day and three-month options invert the consolidated annual approach; the 'no specific timeline' option ignores the explicit one-month-after-financial-year-end requirement. Note: Kept the keyed annual consolidated intimation answer and the revised-section detail. Replaced the unsupported 'material changes must be informed immediately' statement with source-backed wording that material changes are addressed through the prescribed material-change/exit-process framework.
